summary.text: James Scamman is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired travel counselor, he is a University of New Hampshire graduate born in Exeter.

paragraphs.text: James Scamman was born in Exeter, New Hampshire, attended Exeter Area High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1979.
His career experience includes working as a travel counselor, and he lists his profession as retired.
Scamman has been affiliated with the American Contract Bridge League.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Scamman described himself as a lifelong Stratham resident, the current Stratham School District treasurer and a lifetime member of the Stratham Historical Society.
He listed his campaign's key messages as no income tax, no sales tax and protecting the 2nd Amendment, and said Ways and Means was the committee that interested him.
Scamman advanced from the Republican primary for Rockingham 12 on September 8, 2026.
